document.abstract: SINCE the presentation at the Atlantic City Meeting of the methods and apparatus employed in the transmission and reception of photographic images by radio, development has progressed quite satisfactorily. The quality of the reproduction has been raised, while the time required for the transmission of photographs has been reduced to less than a minute.
